newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall, export demand low.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall, export demand low.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell on Thursday to 1,077/1,078 rupees from 1,086/1,087 rupees per quintal on low export demand, dealers said.
"Export demand was dull while rising new crop arrivals triggered renewed selling pressure," one dealer said.
Overall sentiment was subdued but short-covering is seen triggering modest recovery from current levels.
Groundnut oil fell to 353/354 rupees from 356/357 rupees per 10 kg as festival buying eased. Continuing new crop arrivals kept the market quiet.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 535/540 rupees per 15 kg.
